# Hash-locked requirements for the isolated managed-Tiled server environment of the :local
# image (/opt/tiled/venv; Dockerfile stage tiled-server-build) and the CI Tiled job.
# T28C / AUD-08 (B24): every line below is pinned and carries the sha256 of every wheel and
# sdist PyPI serves for that version, so `pip install --require-hashes -r` refuses anything
# else. The versions are exactly the ones in constraints.txt (tests/packaging check that the
# two agree); constraints.txt stays the human-readable version list.
#
# The tiled entry carries the owner-pinned wheel hash PINNED_TILED_WHEEL_SHA256
# (app/modules/deployment/tiled_config.py), which the Dockerfile also checks with sha256sum
# before anything is installed.
#
# Regenerate (network: PyPI only), never hand-edit:
#   echo 'tiled[server]==0.2.18' > /tmp/tiled.in
#   uv pip compile /tmp/tiled.in --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 \
#     --generate-hashes --no-strip-extras -c docker/profiles/tiled-server/constraints.txt \
#     -o docker/profiles/tiled-server/constraints.lock.txt
#   (then restore this header; uv 0.6.10 was used on 2026-10-29)
